program.name: Weekly Mix Express
program.subject: Weekly mix
program.blurb: Every shelf in a week, under half an hour a day.
program.about: A short day from each part of the library, a week at a time. A mixed legs day, boxing, upper-body strength, a conditioning circuit, core and grip, power yoga and a mobility day take turns. Each one is under half an hour. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Mixed / boxing / upper strength / circuit / core & grip / yoga / mobility, short
